Aasha · For parents and caregivers

Understand your child’s everyday needs

Answer simple questions about what you notice at home. Get a clear summary to take to your child’s doctor.

For one child aged 0–12 years. This check-in helps you prepare for a conversation. It is not a diagnostic test.

1. Your child   /   2. Questions   /   3. Your summary

Start with your child’s age

We’ll show questions that fit their age, one at a time. Think about a usual day. You can go back or choose “Not sure” at any point.

No name is needed. Answers stay in this tab unless you choose to save or share them. Refreshing the page clears unsaved progress.

For a baby under 1 year, enter 0 years and their age in months.

Choose one answer, then select Next.

    About this check-in

    Questions adapt to age and your answers. There is no risk score or pass/fail result. You can speak to your child’s doctor at any point, regardless of the summary.

    This questionnaire has not yet been clinically reviewed or validated. It cannot confirm or rule out autism, ADHD or a developmental difficulty. Read about developmental monitoring and screening and discussing developmental concerns.
